locked_owner_decisions.decision: Approve explicit mapping (Wholesale -> bulk, Individual -> individual). RS-002054 remains bulk. Do not add Product.salesType. Do not automatically derive allowIndividualSale unless proven identical.
Approve Design B: Product.sku is authoritative key. sourceSystem and sourceKey belong on SourceRecordMapping with composite unique constraint. Do not add Product.sourceKey.
Remove inferred packaging conversions. conversionToBase = 1 for all imported items. Introduce packQuantity (nullable) to ProductPackaging.
Remove cached pricing fields. ProductPrice is the only authoritative price store.
Phase 3C commit sets status -> pending_review. activatedAt and activatedById remain null.

CLI performs no writes. Commits strictly require a protected Admin API/session endpoint which derives actor identity from the authenticated session. Any client-provided actor identity must be ignored.
